questions.question: AWS, Azure va GCP asosiy tushunchalarini solishtiring.
questions.explanation: AWS, Azure va GCP asosiy tushunchalarini solishtiring.

questions.question: GCP Global VPC arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: GCP'da VPC global resurs — barcha region'larni qamraydi; subnet'lar region'ga tegishli. Turli region'dagi instance'lar VPN yoki peering'siz Google ichki backbone orqali private IP bilan gaplashadi.

questions.question: GKE Autopilot nima?
questions.explanation: Google butun klaster infrasini (node provision, autoscaling, auto-repair, OS patch, hardening) boshqaradigan rejim; to'lov faqat so'ralgan Pod resurslari uchun.

questions.question: Google Cloud Run nima?
questions.explanation: Stateless container image'larni bevosita ishga tushiradigan serverless platforma; HTTP trafik yoki Pub/Sub event'lariga ko'ra 0 dan minglabgacha avtomatik scale.

questions.question: Google Cloud Spanner nima?
questions.explanation: Global taqsimlangan, gorizontal scale qiluvchi relational DB: global miqyosda external consistency (ACID); TrueTime API (atom soat + GPS) ga tayanadi. CAP bo'yicha amalda CP, lekin juda yuqori availability bilan.

questions.question: Google BigQuery nima?
questions.explanation: Serverless cloud data warehouse: columnar storage (Capacitor) va distributed execution (Dremel) bilan petabayt hajmdagi SQL so'rovlar.

questions.question: GCP Workload Identity Federation nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi workload'lar (GitHub Actions, on-prem, AWS) GCP API'ga OIDC token bilan bevosita autentifikatsiya qiladi — uzoq muddatli service account JSON kalit kerak emas.

questions.question: Azure Resource Manager (ARM) va Bicep nima?
questions.explanation: ARM: API so'rovlarini qayta ishlab Resource Group'larda resurs yaratadigan boshqaruv qatlami.

questions.question: Azure Managed Identity (System-assigned va User-assigned) nima?
questions.explanation: Entra ID'da avtomatik boshqariladigan identity: Azure resurslari (VM, App Service) boshqa servislarga (Key Vault) kodda credential saqlamasdan autentifikatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: Azure Virtual WAN nima?
questions.explanation: Filial ulanishlari (VPN/SD-WAN), on-prem (ExpressRoute) va multi-region VNet'larni bitta markaziy tranzit hub'ga birlashtiradigan boshqariladigan tarmoq servisi.

questions.question: Azure Front Door va Application Gateway farqi.
questions.explanation: Front Door (global L7): global web accelerator va CDN — Anycast routing, global load balancing, edge'da TLS offload.

questions.question: Azure Cosmos DB va uning consistency modellari qanday?
questions.explanation: Global taqsimlangan multi-model NoSQL DB; beshta consistency darajasi: Strong, Bounded Staleness, Session (default), Consistent Prefix, Eventual — kuchlidan kuchsizga latency va availability evaziga.

questions.question: GCP Pub/Sub nima?
questions.explanation: Global taqsimlangan asinxron messaging servisi: yuqori throughput, past latency, avtomatik scale va dead-letter topic'lar.

questions.question: GCP Anthos (Google Distributed Cloud) nima?
questions.explanation: Google Cloud servislari va Kubernetes boshqaruvini on-prem va boshqa cloud'larga (AWS/Azure) kengaytiradigan platforma.

questions.question: Multi-cloud strategiyasi nima va trade-off'lari?
questions.explanation: Workload'larni bir nechta provayderda ishlatish — vendor lock-in'dan qochish va eng yaxshi servislarni tanlash uchun.

questions.question: AWS Control Tower va Landing Zone nima?
questions.explanation: Markaziy identity (IAM Identity Center), avtomatik guardrail'lar (SCP) va markaziy logging bilan to'g'ri qurilgan multi-account muhitni avtomatik yaratadigan servis.

questions.question: AWS Organizational Unit (OU) nima?
questions.explanation: Organization ichida akkauntlarni mantiqiy guruhlash — ierarxik SCP qo'llash uchun (Core OU, Workloads OU).

questions.question: Cloud FinOps va FinOps lifecycle nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud xarajatini optimallashtirish framework'i, uch uzluksiz faza: Inform (tag, xarajat taqsimoti), Optimize (right-sizing, chegirma majburiyatlari), Operate (doimiy governance).

questions.question: AWS Cost & Usage Report (CUR) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS xarajat va foydalanish bo'yicha eng to'liq dataset: soatlik/kunlik CSV/Parquet fayllar S3'ga, Athena va QuickSight'da tahlil.

questions.question: FinOps'da Infracost qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: PR'dagi Terraform'ni parse qilib, taklif qilingan o'zgarishning oylik xarajat ta'sirini hisoblab PR'ga izoh qoldiradi.

questions.question: Cloud optimizatsiyasida Kubernetes right-sizing nima?
questions.explanation: Container requests va limits ni haqiqiy tarixiy foydalanishga moslash — ortiqcha bo'sh resurs isrofini yo'qotish.

questions.question: Cloud egress xarajati nima va qanday kamaytiriladi?
questions.explanation: Ma'lumot cloud'dan internetga yoki region'lar orasida chiqqanda olinadigan to'lov. CDN (CloudFront), VPC Endpoint va yuqori hajmli aloqani bir AZ ichida saqlash bilan kamaytiriladi.

questions.question: Cross-AZ data transfer xarajati nima?
questions.explanation: Bir region ichida turli AZ'lar orasidagi trafik uchun to'lov (masalan har yo'nalishda ~$0.01/GB). Chatty servislar va replikatsiyada sezilarli summaga aylanadi.

questions.question: AWS Network Firewall nima?
questions.explanation: VPC ichida L3–L7 trafikni Suricata-mos qoidalar bilan tekshiradigan stateful boshqariladigan firewall va IDS/IPS.

questions.question: AWS Security Lake nima?
questions.explanation: AWS va third-party xavfsizlik telemetriyasini (CloudTrail, Flow Logs, Route 53, GuardDuty) OCSF formatida S3 data lake'ga avtomatik markazlashtiradi.

questions.question: IAM Access Analyzer nima?
questions.explanation: Resource-based policy'larni (S3 bucket policy, KMS, IAM role) formal matematik mulohaza bilan tahlil qilib, tashqi akkauntlarga ochiq resurslarni topadi; ishlatilmagan ruxsatlarni ham ko'rsatadi.

questions.question: AWS Macie nima?
questions.explanation: ML va pattern matching bilan S3'dagi sezgir shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni (PII) topib, tasniflab, ogohlantiradigan servis.

questions.question: CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud konfiguratsiyalarini compliance standartlariga (CIS, NIST, PCI-DSS) nisbatan uzluksiz avtomatik baholash — misconfiguration va drift'ni topish.

questions.question: CWPP (Cloud Workload Protection Platform) nima?
questions.explanation: VM, container va serverless workload'larni runtime'da xulq anomaliyasi, zaiflik skani va intrusion detection bilan himoyalovchi tool'lar.

questions.question: CIEM (Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management) nima?
questions.explanation: Multi-cloud'da least privilege'ni boshqarish: ortiqcha huquqli service account va ishlatilmagan IAM ruxsatlarini aniqlash.

questions.question: AWS App Runner nima?
questions.explanation: VPC yoki load balancer boshqarmasdan source kod yoki image'dan container web ilova/API'ni deploy qilish uchun to'liq boshqariladigan servis.

questions.question: AWS Copilot CLI nima?
questions.explanation: ECS va Fargate'da production-ready container ilovalarni build, reliz va operatsiya qilish uchun ochiq kodli CLI.

questions.question: AWS SAM nima?
questions.explanation: CloudFormation'ni qisqa sintaksis bilan kengaytiruvchi ochiq framework va CLI: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB'ni e'lon qilish, lokal test.

questions.question: Serverless Framework nima?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ YAML bilan serverless ilovalarni (Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions) deploy qiluvchi ochiq multi-cloud framework.

questions.question: AWS CDK nima?
questions.explanation: Infrani dasturlash tillarida (TypeScript, Python, Go, Java) yozish framework'i; CloudFormation template'ga synthesize bo'ladi.

questions.question: Pulumi nima?
questions.explanation: Umumiy dasturlash tillari bilan AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes resurslarini provision qiladigan IaC platformasi.

questions.question: Crossplane Composite Resource Definition (XRD) nima?
questions.explanation: Platform jamoasi belgilaydigan custom Kubernetes API: bir nechta cloud resursini (S3 + IAM role + RDS) dasturchilar uchun bitta abstraksiyaga jamlaydi.

questions.question: AWS VPC Lattice nima?
questions.explanation: VPC'lar va compute turlari (EKS, ECS, Lambda, EC2) bo'ylab service-to-service aloqani murakkab routing yoki proxy'siz ulaydigan, kuzatadigan va himoyalaydigan application-layer tarmoq servisi.

questions.question: AWS Cloud WAN nima?
questions.explanation: Region, VPC va on-prem data center'larni markaziy policy orqali bog'laydigan global WAN'ni qurish va boshqarish servisi.

questions.question: AWS App Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: Envoy asosidagi boshqariladigan service mesh: ECS, EKS, EC2 bo'ylab trafik bo'lish va end-to-end telemetriya. (Eslatma: AWS uni 2026-yilda to'xtatishini e'lon qilgan — VPC Lattice yoki Istio'ga migratsiya.)
